description: The minimum a wrapped site needs for its hover toolbar and for generic cosmetic filtering.
comment: Wrapped windows show somebody else's page, so this grants remote origins the ability to call ZWebWrap commands. Only two exist and both assume a hostile caller: `zww_page_selectors` is read-only, and `zww_window_action` acts on the calling window with a fixed action list and never takes a URL. No core or plugin permissions are granted here - the manager keeps those.
comment2: Four patterns, not two. A URL pattern with no port means the protocol's default, so `https://*` covers ordinary sites but silently denies anything on an explicit port — a wrapped intranet dashboard on `http://server:8080/` got no toolbar, no cosmetic filtering and no find, with every failure swallowed by its caller. The `:*` variants cover those; the trailing `/*` covers paths below the root.
